atlases.a:
Use case: precise-object-edit and stylized-concept. ONE square 3x3 white UI glyph atlas, strict nine equal cells, ROW-MAJOR ORDER. The provided reference supplies EXACT saved edit targets in cells 2-6. Cell 1 is deliberately blank because the GM wants an entirely new uncrossed composition. Cells 7-9 are blank NEW fuel grade slots. Preserve unmentioned parts of cells 2-6; create the new layouts in 1 and 7-9.
PURE solid WHITE #FFFFFF glyphs on clean pure BLACK #000000 background. Serious minimal flat utilitarian dnd5e stencil language, broad shapes and broad negative-space cutouts, readable at 16/24/32px. No grey shading, gradients, texture, speckles, grunge, scratches, tiny hatching, decorative badges, giant generic cogs, cartoon glove proportions, readable lettering, brands, numerals, logos, watermark, grid lines or borders. No gore. Every subject centered fully within the middle 60% of its own cell; minimum20% blank margin on EVERY side. Whole heads, all hands, tools, can caps and handles remain complete and uncropped. Do not let any mark enter a neighboring cell.
ROW-MAJOR CONTENTS:
1. bebeszenie_revision_f: Redesign the entire composition into TWO balanced, uncrossed groups separated by a small central vertical lightning-bolt divider. LEFT: one upright butcher's knife beside a LARGE simple ribcage outline; RIGHT: one stack of two broad printed circuit boards beside one smaller intact pair of pliers. Knife, ribcage, PCB stack and pliers are separate non-touching silhouettes with generous black gaps. Ribcage is comparable in height to the tools, never tiny decoration above them. No crossed tools, skull, hands or gore. Keep the pliers' two straight symmetric handles below one pivot. The modest central lightning bolt divides organic butchery from electronic salvage; no text.
2. pan-plaster_revision_c: Keep BOTH medic hands, their exact positions/gestures, the dressing and the first-aid pouch UNCHANGED. Rotate ONLY the patient's forearm/hand 90 degrees counterclockwise LEFT around the dressing contact area: it must now run toward upper-left rather than upper-right, the opposite diagonal. The patient's whole wrist, palm, thumb and four fingers remain connected and visible. Do not rotate, move, mirror or redraw either medic hand. Exactly three complete hands, no new tool, injury or blood.
3. pierwotny-instynkt_revision_c: Keep the same rugged adult expression, alert head turn, raised ready forearm and three broad disturbance arcs. SIMPLIFY the face: retain only one broad brow/eye cut, a clear nose contour and a single plain mouth line; retain one solid beard silhouette if needed. Remove cheek creases, wrinkle lines, individual stubble hairs, tiny hatch marks and fine forehead detail. Preserve the alert stern expression, no anime styling or younger replacement face.
4. szybki-bill_revision_b: Keep the exact running survivor's pose, two arms, two legs and all body proportions. Add THREE broad short horizontal SPEED STROKES to the LEFT of the runner, behind the back and trailing leg, with clear black space separating them from the body. The lines indicate rapid movement toward the right. No arrowheads, duplicate body, extra limb or lettering.
5. ucz-sie-ucz_revision_b: Keep the two studying hands and open manual with its simple right-page diagram. REMOVE the wrench completely and leave that lower area blank. Add four short broad abstract parallel line marks to the LEFT page, suggesting paragraphs without any readable letters, words or numbers. Preserve the book outline, page turn and hand positions. No new tool or text.
6. ukryty-cel_revision_b: Spread the scene horizontally: shooter on the LEFT, one broad cover slab at CENTER, target figure on the RIGHT with an obvious black gap separating target from the slab. Leave generous space between shooter and slab too. Show one clear horizontal shot path from the rifle muzzle THROUGH a small hole in the slab and ending at the target's torso, with one restrained impact mark. Full target head and shoulders visible, two anatomically coherent figures and one gun. The shot penetrates cover rather than going around its edge. No blood, wound detail, death depiction, labels or extra shots.
7. Paliwo dobre (5 l): One clean sturdy METAL fuel jerrycan with a broad squared rectangular body, a neat triple bridge handle, securely latched corner cap and one large diamond-shaped pressed reinforcing panel. Upright practical five-litre can, intact manufactured silhouette. No letters, brand, numerals, stars, medals, gradients or texture.
8. Paliwo przeciętne (5 l): One ordinary utilitarian METAL fuel can with a slightly rounded tall body, ONE simple carrying loop, ordinary screw cap and a broad X-shaped pressed reinforcement panel. A small broad dent in one shoulder conveys a used but serviceable container. Clearly distinguish its rounded body/single loop/X panel from the clean square triple-handle good-fuel can. No rust specks, fine wear, lettering, logo or number.
9. Paliwo chrzczone (5 l): One reused squat PLASTIC fuel jug with a large molded side handle, broad screw cap and one thick plain repair-tape band around its middle. A simple broad side inspection window shows two separated liquid layers as two large white masses divided by one thick black horizontal gap, implying adulteration. Distinct squat plastic jug silhouette, no text, hazard label, droplets floating outside it, tiny scratches or brand.
CRITICAL CHECKS:
Cell 1 has BALANCED uncrossed organic and electronic halves: LARGE ribs with butcher knife on left, small divider bolt in middle, boards and intact straight-handled pliers on right. No old tiny ribs above crossed tools.
Cell 2 patient's complete forearm must run from LOWER-RIGHT toward UPPER-LEFT, rather than the original lower-left toward upper-right. Its fingers face upper-left. The TWO operating medic hands and pouch stay in the original positions and gestures.
Cell 3 keep the expression but remove fine facial creases/stubble detail.
Cell 4 THREE speed strokes are behind the runner on his LEFT, never connected to limbs.
Cell 5 no wrench; LEFT page has abstract paragraph lines, no real letters.
Cell 6 target stands visibly to RIGHT of cover, with distance from both cover and shooter; a single shot line penetrates a hole through the cover and ends at target torso with a tiny impact, no injury detail.
Cells 7-9 belong to one family but must differ structurally: clean SQUARE metal triple-handle + diamond panel; ROUNDED metal single-loop + X panel; SQUAT plastic side-handle + repair band + layered inspection window. No fuel labels or colors.
